unitCode.description: Default entry unit code, used when dataType = MEASUREMENT. Must resolve to a real Unit within unitCategoryId.

unitCategoryId.description: Which UnitCategory this MEASUREMENT attribute is a quantity of (e.g. LENGTH, MASS) — required when dataType = MEASUREMENT.

aggregatable.description: Opt in to DPP composition aggregation (a component's value is scaled by its BOM percentage and summed into the parent product's composed DPP). Allowed for dataType = DECIMAL, or MEASUREMENT with unitCategoryId set ( — component values are converted to the category's canonical unit before summing, so mismatched units never get silently added together).
